filters.name: Reconstruct Surface by Volumetric Merging
filters.shortDescription: A volumetric surface reconstruction algorithm that creates a mesh from all visible layers.
filters.longDescriptionMarkdown: Surface reconstruction algorithm using volumetric distance fields and Marching Cubes. All visible meshes/point clouds are used to build the volumetric field. Supports sub-volume splitting for very high resolution reconstructions, geodesic weighting for smooth blending of overlapping range maps, hole filling via volume dilation, and optional vertex splatting.

parameters.label: Voxel Side
parameters.help: The side length of each voxel. A percentage of the bounding box diagonal.

parameters.label: SubVol Splitting
parameters.help: The level of recursive splitting (1 = no split, 3 = 3×3×3 subdivision producing 27 sub-meshes).

parameters.label: Geodesic Weighting
parameters.help: Weight each range map by geodesic distance from borders for smooth blending of overlaps.

parameters.label: Volume Laplacian iter
parameters.help: Number of volume Laplacian smoothing steps to clean out noisy borders.

parameters.label: Widening
parameters.help: How many voxels the field is expanded. Larger values fill more holes.

parameters.label: Vertex Splatting
parameters.help: Splat vertices into the grid instead of rasterizing faces. Requires at least one sample per voxel.

parameters.label: Post Merge simplification
parameters.help: Automatically simplify the mesh after reconstruction.

parameters.label: PreSmooth iter
parameters.help: Face normal Laplacian iterations before voxelization. Helps with noisy borders.

filters.name: Simplify Marching-Cubes Mesh by Edge Collapse
filters.shortDescription: Simplify only meshes generated by Marching Cubes, preserving the grid structure.
filters.longDescriptionMarkdown: A simplification/cleaning algorithm that works only on meshes generated by Marching Cubes. It detects the grid spacing automatically and collapses redundant edges while preserving the bounding box.

parameters.label: Error (MC cell units)
parameters.help: Collapse error in MC cell units. 0.25 = 1/4 of a cell side (original default). 1.0 = 1 full cell side (more aggressive). 0.0 = auto (same as 0.25).

parameters.label: Preserve bounding box
parameters.help: If true, vertices on the bounding box are not collapsed.

parameters.label: Flip threshold
parameters.help: T-vertex removal aggressiveness. Higher = more removal. Default 10. A vertex within 1/threshold of the edge length is considered a T-vertex.
